Career Profile

I’m Eun Jung, a Master’s student in the Electrical and Computer Engineering department at Sungkyunkwan University, advised by Professor Hyoungshick Kim. I received my Bachelor’s degree in Data Technology (Software Convergence) from Myongji University.

Previsouly, I served as a Visiting Researcher at the University of Maryland, College Park, advised by Professor Yongwhi Kwon at the the University of Maryland Cybersecurity Center.
